## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant build/tests passed
- [ ] I inspected the actual diff
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots of the rendered result
- [ ] Major UI changes were compared against the approved visual direction
- [ ] New/changed behavior has appropriate regression coverage
- [ ] Privacy/data promises still match the implementation
- [ ] Accessibility impact was checked where relevant
- [ ] Performance/background-work impact was checked where relevant

## UI evidence, when applicable

Include representative screenshots for the states that changed. Do not approve a visual redesign from source code alone.

- [ ] populated / normal
- [ ] empty / first run
- [ ] permission denied / error, when relevant
- [ ] light + dark, when relevant
- [ ] large font / accessibility, when relevant

## Product maturity

This change leaves the app at:

- [ ] Prototype
- [ ] Feature-complete
- [ ] Beta-ready
- [ ] Production-ready

If selecting **Production-ready**, link the completed evidence from `docs/production-quality-gate.md`. A passing build alone is not sufficient.
